quizzes.question_text: Without using a calculator, order the following numbers from least to greatest. $$\\[1em] 10, \sqrt{78}, 9 \\[1em]$$
quizzes.question_type: Multiple Choice Question with Single Answer
solution: To order these, we want to approximate what number multiplied by itself gives us 78.
Test numbers by multiplying integers with themselves: $$\\[0.5em]$$ • $$7 \times 7 = 49$$ (too small) $$\\[0.5em]$$ • $$8 \times 8 = 64$$ (too small) $$\\[0.5em]$$ • $$9 \times 9 = 81$$ (too big)
Narrow it down — since 78 is between 64 and 81, $$\sqrt{78}$$ is between 8 and 9.
So the order from least to greatest is: $$\sqrt{78}, 9, 10$$.
